rows.title: Backlog point bubbles and the Epic panel show point totals with floating-point noise ('0.30000000000000004')
rows.summary: Now: point totals are rounded to 2 decimals (boardQuery roundPoints) in issueStats (Epic panel, section stats, project summary) and in the new pointsByCategory that PointBubbles uses, so 0.1 + 0.2 reads 0.3 and 1.1 + 2.2 reads 3.3; whole and half points add as before.

notes: Base moved to 22fb602e (origin/claude/r4-green head at start). CI run 36644706908: failfirst green, tests (new test, board-query, knowledge-docs) green, lint green. No docs/knowledge text describes point totals, so no doc change.
